svg.title: OrgGraph database entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: All columns and SQL types in nine tables. PK marks primary keys and FK marks foreign keys. Each foreign-key constraint has its own connection with crow’s-foot cardinality.
svg.text: PK Primary key FK Foreign key Each line represents one foreign-key constraint
Circle = optional · bar = one · fork = many. Solid = identifying relationship · dashed = non-identifying.
